# Find Nov 27 transcripts mentioning 指标/column/回填
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,re
bases=[
 Path("/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts"),
 Path.home()/".dc-platform/memory/mirrors/agent-transcripts",
]
day_marker="Friday, Nov 27, 2026"
keys=("指标库","column_id","回填","设备标签","归因","backfill")
found=[]
for base in bases:
  if not base.exists(): continue
  for p in base.rglob("*.jsonl"):
    try:
      raw=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
    except: continue
    if day_marker not in raw and "2026-11-27" not in raw: continue
    hit_keys=[k for k in keys if k in raw]
    if not hit_keys: continue
    # extract user queries with Nov 27
    users=[]
    for line in raw.splitlines():
      try: o=json.loads(line)
      except: continue
      msg=o.get("message") or {}
      role=msg.get("role") or o.get("role")
      content=msg.get("content")
      text=""
      if isinstance(content,list):
        text="\n".join(c.get("text","") for c in content if isinstance(c,dict) and c.get("type")=="text")
      elif isinstance(content,str): text=content
      if role=="user" and ("Nov 27, 2026" in text or "2026-11-27" in text):
        # strip tags roughly
        m=re.search(r"<user_query>\s*(.*?)\s*</user_query>", text, re.S)
        q=m.group(1).strip() if m else text[:300]
        users.append(q[:250].replace("\n"," "))
    found.append((p, hit_keys, users))
print("files", len(found))
for p, hk, users in found:
  print("---", p)
  print("keys", hk)
  for u in users[:10]:
    print("U:", u[:220])
PY
